skill.name: pexo-agent
skill.description: Pexo Agent helps AI coding agents create finished videos through the Pexo API. It supports project creation, media upload, chat-based revisions, polling, and final asset delivery.
skill.summary: Create finished AI videos through Pexo from prompts, media files, scripts, and revision requests.
skill.author: pexoai

security_audit.summary: The skill is an outbound Pexo API client that requires shell scripts, a PEXO_API_KEY, local media upload, project polling, and asset delivery. Most static command-substitution, documentation, and troubleshooting matches are safe in context, but sourcing ~/.pexo/config as shell, sending bearer credentials to a configurable endpoint, uploading user media, and sharing signed URLs remain material risks. No direct malware behavior was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Config files are sourced as shell scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Replace source-based config loading with a strict key-value parser, reject unexpected keys, and require config permissions equivalent to owner-read/write only.

remediation.issue: Bearer credentials are sent to a configurable base URL.
remediation.suggestion: Validate PEXO_BASE_URL against approved Pexo domains or require an explicit warning and confirmation before sending credentials to any override.

remediation.issue: User media can be uploaded to external storage.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before uploading files or downloading user-provided URLs, and show the exact local path or URL that will be sent.

remediation.issue: Signed asset URLs are shared in full.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users that signed URLs grant temporary access to generated media, avoid logging them, and prefer short-lived links when the API supports them.

remediation.issue: Prompt-priority wording appears in skill instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Remove highest-priority and non-negotiable phrasing from skill content, and state language preferences without claiming priority over system or platform instructions.

content.value_statement: Video production often requires model selection, media handling, and repeated status checks. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a guided workflow for Pexo projects, uploads, revisions, and delivery.
actual_capabilities: Creates Pexo video projects from a user brief.
Uploads supported image, video, and audio files to a Pexo project.
Sends chat instructions and preview choices to Pexo.
Polls project status and interprets the next required action.
Retrieves final asset metadata, signed download URLs, and local cached files.
Runs diagnostics for config, dependencies, network access, and API key validity.
limitations: Requires a PEXO_API_KEY and outbound HTTPS access to Pexo.
Sends user prompts and uploaded media to the Pexo service.
Does not generate or edit video locally.
Requires local shell tools including curl, jq, and file.

use_cases.title: Produce campaign videos
use_cases.description: Create short promotional videos from a campaign brief, then collect previews and revisions in one project.

use_cases.title: Convert product media into ads
use_cases.description: Upload product photos or clips, send the desired message, and receive a finished video asset.

use_cases.title: Manage social video drafts
use_cases.description: Create vertical videos, poll production status, review previews, and request changes through Pexo chat.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple product video
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request from a short brief.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15-second vertical product video for my new running shoes. Make it energetic and suitable for Instagram Reels.

prompt_templates.title: Use uploaded media as reference
prompt_templates.scenario: User provides an image, video, or audio file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the uploaded product photo as the main reference. Create a clean 20-second ad that highlights comfort, durability, and launch pricing.

prompt_templates.title: Revise a preview choice
prompt_templates.scenario: User selected a preview and wants changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose preview B. Make the opening shot brighter, shorten the text on screen, and keep the music upbeat.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a multi-shot campaign video
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with structure and delivery requirements.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second brand video with four scenes: problem, product reveal, customer moment, and call to action. Use a modern style and prepare it for 16:9 and 9:16 delivery.

output_examples.input: Create a 15-second vertical product ad from my uploaded shoe photo.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates a Pexo project, uploads the image, submits the request, shares the project page, and returns preview options when ready.

output_examples.input: Check why Pexo is not working on this machine.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports whether the config file, API key, required tools, network access, and Pexo authentication check passed.

output_examples.input: Deliver the final video for this project.
output_examples.output: The assistant retrieves the final asset, downloads a local copy when available, shares the full signed download link, and asks whether revisions are needed.

best_practices: Confirm that uploaded files can be sent to Pexo before starting production.
Store the API key in a restricted config file or environment variable.
Poll at the recommended interval and avoid duplicate chat messages while production is waiting.
anti_patterns: Do not upload private or regulated media without explicit permission.
Do not paste full API keys into chat, logs, or shared documents.
Do not send repeated chat requests while a project is already producing a video.

faq.question: Does this skill create video locally?
faq.answer: No. It sends requests and media to Pexo, then retrieves project status and final assets.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: The scripts require PEXO_API_KEY. PEXO_BASE_URL is also used for the Pexo API endpoint.

faq.question: Can it upload files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can upload supported image, video, and audio files to a Pexo project.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users review before installing?
faq.answer: Users should review outbound network access, API key handling, local config sourcing, and media upload behavior.

faq.question: What happens when credits are insufficient?
faq.answer: The scripts report the credit issue, fetch entitlement details when possible, and point the user to Pexo credit purchase steps.
